hooks.command: for p in python python3; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/rules_hook.py" pre-shell; fi; done; exit 0
for p in python python3; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/rules_hook.py" post-write; fi; done; exit 0
for p in python python3; do if command -v "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.claude/hooks/rules_hook.py" stop claude; fi; done; exit 0
